title: LNutty Gooey Indulgent Rest-meat Tagine
description: A rich and indulgent Portuguese dish featuring ancho chilies, rest-meat, and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: 4 oz rest-meat (ground beef, lamb, or pork)
1/4 tsp saffron threads, soaked in warm water for 30 min

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe pot over medium heat.
Add onions and garlic; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in ground meat and chili powder. Cook for another 5-7 minutes or until browned.
Pour in diced tomatoes, add cumin, and soaked saffron water.
Simmer gently on medium-low heat for 20 minutes to let flavors meld together.
Reduce heat to lowest setting and cook uncovered for an additional 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot with crusty bread or as a side dish.
